row.title: CODE-REGULATOR-1 failure-mode audit and fixes
row.body: Audit of the regulator's failure modes: seven fixes, each with a test. Evidence outside the repository raises an error; a broken symlink is skipped by the index; dot-slash paths keep the impact set; an exhausted step menu opens one escalation; the token hook drops bad input and exits 0; CLI usage errors exit 2; the ledger connection closes. Ran 27 regulator tests, they pass. Root cause of most: input shape trusted at a boundary. Concurrent writers on one SQLite file are now covered: WAL plus a 5 second busy timeout, tested with three processes writing 300 rows and none lost. Remaining scope to audit next: very large repositories, tracked as the next probe.
